column1: P_L1_U01|demonstrative|介绍一个与多个教室物品|What's this? It is a window.|这是什么？这是一扇窗户。|What are these? They are windows.|这些是什么？这些是窗户。|把this pencil换成these pencils，写问答。|What are these? They are pencils.
P_L1_U02|can|解释五感能做什么|I can see with my eyes.|我能用眼睛看。|I can hear with my ears.|我能用耳朵听。|用with说明你能用手触摸。|I can touch with my hands.
P_L1_U03|adjective|用外貌特点介绍农场动物|This is a funny dog with a long tail.|这是一只长着长尾巴的滑稽的狗。|The cat is small and happy.|这只猫很小，也很开心。|用black nose描述一只小狗。|The dog has a black nose.
P_L1_U04|politerequest|礼貌分享食物|Can I have some chocolate, please? Here you are.|请给我一些巧克力，好吗？给你。|Would you like a burger? No, thank you.|你想要一个汉堡吗？不用，谢谢。|礼貌询问朋友是否想要一些冰激凌。|Would you like some ice cream?
P_L1_U05|does|猜朋友想要什么生日礼物|Does he want a robot? No, he doesn't.|他想要机器人吗？不，他不想。|What does he want? He wants a helicopter.|他想要什么？他想要直升机。|询问她是否想要一只泰迪熊。|Does she want a teddy bear?
P_L1_U06|lets|一起设计动物游戏|Let's make a game. That's a good idea.|我们来制作一个游戏吧。好主意。|Let's go to the zoo and look at the animals.|我们去动物园看动物吧。|邀请朋友画一只老虎。|Let's draw a tiger.
P_L1_U07|can|读懂运动场上的许可与禁止|Can we play tennis here? Yes, you can.|我们可以在这里打网球吗？可以。|You can't ride bikes here.|你们不能在这里骑自行车。|用can't提醒朋友不能在这里游泳。|You can't swim here.
P_L1_U08|place|介绍家具的位置|The rug is in front of the armchair.|地毯在扶手椅前面。|The lamp is between the armchair and the sofa.|灯在扶手椅和沙发之间。|用behind说钟在沙发后面。|The clock is behind the sofa.
P_L1_U09|gerund|分享假期喜欢的活动|I like swimming in the sea.|我喜欢在海里游泳。|I enjoy playing on the sand.|我喜欢在沙滩上玩。|用enjoy说明你喜欢在海滩拍照。|I enjoy taking photos at the beach.
P_L2_U01|there|比较山地景物的数量|There are rocks on the mountain.|山上有岩石。|There isn't any grass on the ground.|地面上没有草。|说树上没有叶子。|There aren't any leaves on the tree.

P_L2_U02|frequency|采访朋友活动的频率|How often do you listen to music? I often listen to music.|你多久听一次音乐？我经常听音乐。|Do you ever write emails? No, I never write emails.|你写过电子邮件吗？没有，我从不写电子邮件。|用sometimes说你有时购物。|I sometimes go shopping.

P_L2_U03|presentcontrast|对比平时的穿着与今天的戏服|He usually wears a shirt.|他平时通常穿衬衫。|Today, he is wearing a pirate's costume.|今天，他穿着海盗服。|她平时穿裙子，但今天正穿着护士服，用两句表达。|She usually wears a dress. Today, she is wearing a nurse's costume.
P_L2_U04|posspronoun|比较属于不同人的物品|This is my room. That is hers.|这是我的房间。那是她的。|Our dog is small. Theirs is bigger.|我们的狗很小。他们的狗更大。|把My family is big改用Mine开头，前文已明确说family。|Mine is big.
P_L2_U05|place|用动物园地图定位动物|The parrot is above the panda.|鹦鹉在熊猫上方。|The lion is near the rock.|狮子在岩石附近。|用below说海豚在鲸的下方。|The dolphin is below the whale.
P_L2_U06|pastbe|回忆昨天房间里的物品|There was a bag on the floor.|地板上曾有一个包。|Were there any shorts? No, there weren't.|当时有短裤吗？不，没有。|用There were说昨天床上有两件外套。|There were two coats on the bed yesterday.

P_L2_U08|haveto|在城市公共场所遵守规则|You have to be quiet in the library.|在图书馆你必须保持安静。|Does he have to get up early on Saturday? No, he doesn't.|他周六必须早起吗？不，他不必。|用doesn't have to说他周六不必步行上学。|He doesn't have to walk to school on Saturday.
P_L3_U01|question|了解杂技演员的工作时间|What time do they have breakfast?|他们几点吃早餐？|Why do they get up early?|他们为什么早起？|询问这是谁的帽子。|Whose hat is this?

P_L3_U02|when|按时间讲一次早餐后的出行|When we finished breakfast, we went shopping.|吃完早餐后，我们去购物了。|Grandma made a pancake when I was sad.|我难过时，奶奶给我做了一个薄饼。|用When连接We finished lunch和We climbed the wall。|When we finished lunch, we climbed the wall.
P_L3_U03|needwant|表达身体不适与需求|My stomach hurts. I need to see a doctor.|我的肚子疼。我需要看医生。|I want to stay in bed, but I don't want to take medicine.|我想卧床休息，但我不想吃药。|用need to说他需要休息。|He needs to rest.
R_L1_U01|howmany|数一数身体部位|How many hands do you have? I have two hands.|你有几只手？我有两只手。|How many noses do you have? I have one nose.|你有几个鼻子？我有一个鼻子。|询问朋友有几只眼睛。|How many eyes do you have?
R_L1_U02|can|介绍宠物能做什么|My rabbit can jump.|我的兔子会跳。|Can your bird fly? Yes, it can.|你的鸟会飞吗？是的。|说你的猫会爬。|My cat can climb.
R_L1_U03|any|准备体育课用品|Do you have a basketball? Yes, I do.|你有篮球吗？是的，有。|I don't have a football.|我没有足球。|询问朋友有没有排球。|Do you have a volleyball?
R_L3_U01|place|在社区地图上标位置|The bakery is behind the library.|面包店在图书馆后面。|The restaurant is between the store and the library.|餐馆在商店和图书馆之间。|用in front of说公交车在学校前面。|The bus is in front of the school.
R_L3_U02|wantbe|介绍自己未来想做的职业|I want to be a pilot.|我想成为飞行员。|She wants to be a writer.|她想成为作家。|说你的哥哥想成为消防员。|My brother wants to be a firefighter.
R_L4_U02|needwant|解释植物的生存需要|A plant needs air, water, and light.|植物需要空气、水和光。|Living things need energy to grow.|生物需要能量来生长。|用need说这些植物需要水。|These plants need water.

R_L4_U05|compound|用because比较动物异同|Birds and alligators are alike because both have tails.|鸟和短吻鳄相似，因为两者都有尾巴。|They are different because birds have feathers.|它们不同，因为鸟有羽毛。|用but比较老虎有毛、短吻鳄有鳞片。|A tiger has fur, but an alligator has scales.
R_L5_U03|adverb|描述水流动的方式|The clean water flows slowly through the pipe.|干净的水慢慢流过管道。|The water rises quickly after heavy rain.|大雨后水位迅速上升。|用slowly描述水从井中慢慢流出。|Water flows slowly from the well.
R_L5_U05|pronoun|记录月亮和星星的变化|The moon appears at night. It looks bright.|月亮在夜里出现。它看起来很明亮。|The stars appear, too. They look small.|星星也出现了。它们看起来很小。|用They替换The shadows，说明影子在移动。|They are moving.
R_L5_U07|goingto|制定下一次动物观察计划|We are going to watch the birds tomorrow.|我们明天打算观察鸟。|We are not going to disturb them.|我们不打算打扰它们。|说你打算画出它们的栖息地。|I am going to draw their habitat.
R_L6_U02|imperative|给生态观察员发出指令|Show me the river on the map.|给我指出地图上的河。|Point to the animal at the top of the food chain.|指出食物链顶端的动物。|请朋友观察这些植物。|Look at these plants, please.
R_L6_U04|should|为更可持续的市场提出建议|We should buy local food.|我们应该购买本地食物。|We could use less packaging.|我们可以减少包装用量。|建议人们不要浪费水。|People shouldn't waste water.
R_L7_U02|sentencetypes|用不同句式介绍同一种动物|The animal can solve a problem.|这种动物能够解决问题。|Can it use a tool? What a clever animal!|它会使用工具吗？多么聪明的动物啊！|发出指令，让朋友观察它的行为。|Look at its behavior.
R_L7_U06|future|规划寻宝路线|I am going to follow the coastal route.|我打算沿着海岸路线前进。|I will record what I find.|我会记录发现的东西。|用plan to说你打算检查这件文物。|I plan to examine the artifact.
A_L0_U02|has|为怪物画五官并介绍|She has six eyes.|她有六只眼睛。|He has two mouths.|他有两张嘴。|介绍一个有八只耳朵的怪物，用It开头。|It has eight ears.
A_L1_U04|likes|分享宠物喜好|I like dogs, but I don't like spiders.|我喜欢狗，但不喜欢蜘蛛。|Do you like cats? Yes, I do.|你喜欢猫吗？是的。|说自己也喜欢狗。|I like dogs, too.
A_L1_U08|demonstrative|挑选一件与多件衣物|Do you like this hat? Yes, I do.|你喜欢这顶帽子吗？是的。|Do you like these shoes? No, I don't.|你喜欢这些鞋子吗？不，我不喜欢。|询问对方喜不喜欢近处的这条裙子。|Do you like this skirt?
A_L2_U03|place|在海滩寻找玩具|Where is the kite? It is in the tree.|风筝在哪里？在树上。|Where are the balls? They are on the sand.|球在哪里？在沙地上。|询问一本书在哪里，再说在树下。|Where is the book? It is under the tree.
A_L2_U06|place|给朋友指路|The library is between the school and the store.|图书馆在学校和商店之间。|The hospital is behind the park.|医院在公园后面。|用next to说商店在学校旁边。|The store is next to the school.
A_L2_U07|politerequest|在市场礼貌选择食物|What would you like? I'd like some tomatoes.|你想要什么？我想要一些番茄。|Would you like some bread? Yes, please.|你想要一些面包吗？好的，谢谢。|礼貌表示自己想要一些芒果。|I would like some mangoes, please.
A_L2_U08|wouldlike|表达出行愿望与交通方式|I'd like to go to Africa by plane.|我想坐飞机去非洲。|I'd like to go to the jungle by train.|我想坐火车去丛林。|说你想乘船去小岛。|I'd like to go to the island by boat.
A_L3_U01|be|根据表情说心情|Are you tired? Yes, I am.|你累了吗？是的。|I am hungry, but I am not angry.|我饿了，但我没有生气。|用She说她既激动又惊讶。|She is excited and surprised.
A_L3_U02|imperative|发出整理房间的指令|Tidy your room up.|整理你的房间。|Put those dirty shoes in the closet.|把那些脏鞋放进衣柜。|请朋友把这些枕头收好。|Put these pillows away, please.
A_L3_U04|goodat|说明自己擅长的学科与活动|I am good at math.|我擅长数学。|She is good at learning languages.|她擅长学习语言。|说自己不擅长画画。|I am not good at drawing.
A_L3_U08|has|用外形辨认海洋动物|A turtle has a shell.|海龟有龟壳。|Do penguins have feathers? Yes, they do.|企鹅有羽毛吗？是的。|说海豹有毛。|Seals have fur.
A_L4_U01|any|检查野餐食物是否齐全|Do you have any cheese? Yes, I do.|你有奶酪吗？是的。|I would like some juice, but I don't want any lemonade.|我想要一些果汁，但我不想要柠檬水。|询问朋友有没有蔬菜。|Do you have any vegetables?
A_L4_U03|timeprep|介绍家务时间|We sweep the floor in the evening.|我们晚上扫地。|Amanda feeds the dog at ten o'clock.|阿曼达十点喂狗。|说你周一早上做早餐。|I cook breakfast on Monday morning.

A_L5_U03|pastcause|说明目击事故后的行动|I saw an accident, so I called the emergency number.|我看到了事故，所以拨打了急救电话。|The firefighters came and helped the man.|消防员赶来帮助了那个人。|用so说你听到求救声，于是叫了救护车。|I heard a call for help, so I called an ambulance.
A_L6_U01|purpose|解释职业准备的目的|I take drama classes to become an actor.|我上戏剧课是为了成为演员。|I learn new recipes to become a better chef.|我学习新食谱是为了成为更好的厨师。|用to说明你做模型是为了获得经验。|I make models to gain experience.
A_L6_U03|possibility|体育解说中的可能性与提议|This could be the most important point of the game.|这可能是比赛最重要的一分。|Shall we watch that goal again?|我们再看一次那个进球，好吗？|用might说他可能赢得比赛。|He might win the race.
A_L6_U04|politerequest|旅行途中礼貌请求|Could I try on that T-shirt?|我可以试穿那件T恤吗？|Do you mind if I close the door? Not at all.|你介意我关门吗？完全不介意。|礼貌请求试戴那副耳环。|Could I try on those earrings?
A_L6_U05|verbforms|讲述人物决定与行动|They decide to leave the town.|他们决定离开小镇。|She avoids making the same mistake.|她避免犯同样的错误。|用refuse说他拒绝离开。|He refuses to leave.
A_L6_U06|material|为旧物制作博物馆标签|The saddle is made of leather.|这个马鞍是皮革制成的。|It is used for riding horses.|它用于骑马。|说这辆马车是木制的。|The wagon is made of wood.

A_L6_U07|prefer|点餐时表达更喜欢的选项|Do you prefer home-cooked food or fast food?|你更喜欢家常饭还是快餐？|I'd rather have spinach. She made it herself.|我宁愿吃菠菜。她亲自做的。|用prefer ... to说你更喜欢家常饭而非快餐。|I prefer home-cooked food to fast food.

A_L6_U08|compare-super|在旅行介绍中比较地点|This valley is quieter than the harbor.|这片山谷比港口更安静。|It is the most peaceful place on our trip.|它是我们这次旅行中最宁静的地方。|用largest说这是该国最大的港口。|This is the largest harbor in the country.

A_L7_U01|perfect|确认是否体验过新设施|Have you seen the new gym yet? No, I haven't.|你已经看过新体育馆了吗？还没有。|I have already used the new bike rack.|我已经用过新自行车架了。|用yet问朋友是否已经在新球场打过球。|Have you played on the new court yet?
A_L7_U04|should|为低污染生活提出建议|We should use less fuel.|我们应该少用燃料。|We should use solar energy when possible.|条件允许时，我们应该使用太阳能。|建议人们乘坐公共交通。|People should use public transportation.
A_L7_U06|must|说明发射前的必要要求|The astronauts must listen carefully before launch.|宇航员在发射前必须认真倾听。|They must check the control panel.|他们必须检查控制面板。|提醒宇航员必须穿宇航服。|The astronauts must wear spacesuits.

A_L7_U07|goingto|说明未来环境变化的影响|Climate change is going to affect the polar bears.|气候变化将影响北极熊。|We are going to learn how to protect their habitat.|我们打算学习如何保护它们的栖息地。|说你打算观察北极熊幼崽。|I am going to observe the polar bear cubs.
A_L8_U01|perfect|采访人物的经历|Have you ever seen her perform? Yes, I have.|你曾看过她表演吗？是的。|I have never seen her give up.|我从未见过她放弃。|用ever询问朋友是否读过他的故事。|Have you ever read his story?
A_L8_U03|indefinite|讨论网络内容的传播|Everyone is talking about the new video.|每个人都在谈论这个新视频。|Someone has shared my photo, but no one asked me.|有人分享了我的照片，但没人征求我的意见。|说没有人知道你的密码。|No one knows my password.

A_L8_U04|reported|转述证人对事件的描述|The witness said, "I was walking home."|目击者说：“我当时正在走路回家。”|The witness said that she had been walking home.|目击者说，她当时正在走路回家。|把He said, "I am tired."改为过去语境中的间接引语。|He said that he was tired.
A_L8_U05|shortagreement|简短表达相同意见|I like this tradition. So do I.|我喜欢这个传统。我也是。|I don't like rude behavior. Neither do I.|我不喜欢粗鲁的行为。我也不喜欢。|对I am interested in this ceremony表示你也一样。|So am I.

A_L8_U06|firstif|讨论环保行动的未来结果|If we recycle more, we will reduce waste.|如果我们多回收，就会减少垃圾。|Unless we act now, the problem will get worse.|除非我们现在行动，否则问题会加重。|用if说如果人们保护湿地，就会帮助野生动物。|If people protect wetlands, they will help wildlife.

A_L8_U08|secondif|区分现在假设与过去遗憾|If the rule were fairer, more students would accept it.|如果这条规则更公平，更多学生就会接受。|If we had followed the rule, we wouldn't have got into trouble.|如果我们当时遵守了规则，就不会惹麻烦。|假设现在规则更清晰，用If和would表达你能理解它们。|If the rules were clearer, I would understand them.
